hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command')
if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit'; then
  if [[ "$cmd" =~ ^cd\ +\"?([^\"\&]+)\"?\ *\&\& ]]; then
    dir="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    dir="${dir%"${dir##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  b=$(git branch --show-current)
  if [ "$b" = "main" ]; then
    echo 'Blocked: commit on main. Create a branch.' >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -Ei '\.(mp3|wav|m4a|db|sqlite)$' >/dev/null; then
    echo 'Blocked: binary/db files staged' >&2
    exit 2
  fi
fi
